metadata.description: Location for all resources.
Extra tags applied to every deployed resource (merged with the publisher marker tag).
standard = 1 vCPU / 2 GiB, large = 2 vCPU / 4 GiB.
App image pinned by build.sh for each managed-app definition version; vendor-operated updates move instances forward.
PostgreSQL Flexible Server compute SKU (e.g. Standard_B2s, Standard_D2ds_v5).
PostgreSQL compute tier; must match pgSkuName's family.
PostgreSQL storage in GiB. Auto-grow is enabled; redeploys must pass the server's current size.
Days PostgreSQL daily backups are retained.
Replicate PostgreSQL backups to the paired Azure region for cross-region restore (adds backup cost; can only be chosen at first deployment).
Redundancy for the uploads storage account (LRS = single region, GRS = geo-replicated).
Deploy an Azure AI Foundry account with EdSpace model deployments. When false, supply the byoLlm* parameters.
Region for the AI account, decoupled from the app region for model availability.

TPM capacity (thousands) for each chat/text model. Draws on the CUSTOMER subscription quota in aiLocation; each model has its own quota bucket. Sized to admit one worst-case turn (~780) — lowering it can make very large chats hang.
TPM capacity (thousands) for each small/background model (titles, classifiers, reranking).
TPM capacity (thousands) for the embedding model.
Enable voice features via Azure Speech on the AI account (only applies when enableAzureAi is true).
Base URL of your Azure OpenAI-compatible endpoint. Required when enableAzureAi is false; ignored otherwise.
API key for the BYO LLM endpoint. Required when enableAzureAi is false.
Deployment name serving chat/text models on the BYO endpoint.
Deployment name serving small/background models on the BYO endpoint.
Deployment name serving the embedding model (1536 dimensions) on the BYO endpoint.
API version query parameter for the BYO endpoint. Leave empty for the provider default.
Custom public hostname. Leave empty to use the generated *.azurecontainerapps.io address. Custom domains are bound post-install by EdSpace support (see README).
Transactional-email backend. "none" disables email: sign-in then uses a password and/or SSO, and invitation links are shown to the inviting admin to pass on.
MailPace API key. Required when the mailer is MailPace.
From address for all outgoing email, verified with your provider. Required unless the mailer is "none".
Display name for outgoing email.
SMTP relay hostname. Required when the mailer is SMTP.
SMTP relay port. 587 is the STARTTLS submission port.
Implicit TLS from the first byte, paired with port 465. Leave false for the ordinary STARTTLS submission port.
SMTP username. Leave empty for a relay that does not authenticate.
SMTP password for the username above.
Offer "Sign in with Microsoft" (Entra ID, OIDC). Requires an app registration in your tenant whose redirect URI is https://<app host>/auth/microsoft/callback.

Entra tenant to accept sign-ins from: your Directory (tenant) ID, or "organizations" for any work/school account. "common" additionally admits personal Microsoft accounts. Read only when Microsoft SSO is enabled.
Application (client) ID of the Entra app registration. Required when Microsoft SSO is enabled.
Client secret of the Entra app registration. Required when Microsoft SSO is enabled.
Container registry host serving the EdSpace image. Leave at the default unless EdSpace support directs otherwise.
Per-customer registry username from your EdSpace welcome email.
Per-customer registry password/token from your EdSpace welcome email.
Persist generated + user-supplied secrets into the instance Key Vault. true on first install ONLY; vendor-operated redeploys MUST pass false.
Entropy seed for the generated SECRET_KEY_BASE. Leave at the default; only read when bootstrapSecrets is true.
Entropy seed for the generated TOKEN_SIGNING_SECRET. Leave at the default; only read when bootstrapSecrets is true.
Entropy seed for the generated PostgreSQL admin password. Leave at the default; only read when bootstrapSecrets is true.
